recommendations.title: Recheck your resting heart rate tomorrow morning
recommendations.body: Measure resting heart rate right after waking, before getting up or drinking caffeine, so the reading can be compared with your normal.

recommendations.title: Review recent exercise intensity and recovery
recommendations.body: Check whether recent sessions were harder or longer than planned, and allow recovery time as your exercise plan describes.

recommendations.title: Meet today's fluid target
recommendations.body: Log your fluid intake and aim for the mission's daily hydration target. Dehydration can raise heart rate and add to fatigue.

recommendations.title: Follow your prescribed sleep routine tonight
recommendations.body: Dim lighting 60 minutes before your sleep period, avoid screens, keep the sleep station at its assigned temperature and use the 10-minute wind-down audio.

recommendations.title: Check your sleep environment
recommendations.body: Check noise, light leaks and temperature at your sleep station, and report anything that keeps disturbing your sleep.

recommendations.title: Complete the fatigue and stress assessment
recommendations.body: Take the 3-minute fatigue and stress questionnaire in the Wellness Center so changes can be tracked over time.
recommendations.source: Illustrative — replace with mission behavioural-health protocol

recommendations.title: Review your workload and schedule
recommendations.body: Look at the next 3 days of tasks with the crew lead and identify anything that can be moved to protect your sleep period.
recommendations.source: Illustrative — replace with mission behavioural-health protocol

recommendations.title: Try a guided breathing exercise
recommendations.body: Open the Wellness Center and follow the 4-minute guided breathing exercise.
recommendations.source: Illustrative — replace with mission behavioural-health protocol

recommendations.title: Complete today's wellness check-in
recommendations.body: Record sleep, mood, stress and fatigue. It takes under a minute and keeps your personal baseline accurate.

recommendations.title: Recheck your temperature in 30 minutes
recommendations.body: Rest, then measure again with the same thermometer to confirm the reading before acting on it.

recommendations.title: Rest, hydrate and limit contact with crew
recommendations.body: Pause strenuous tasks, increase fluid intake and limit close contact with other crew until the crew medical officer advises otherwise.

recommendations.title: Report any other symptoms
recommendations.body: Log any other symptoms (for example cough, sore throat, headache, rash or stomach upset) so they are included in your next medical report.

recommendations.title: Contact the crew medical officer and flight surgeon
recommendations.body: Tell the crew medical officer now. A priority report is queued for the flight surgeon and will be sent on the next link window.

recommendations.title: Go to the radiation shelter
recommendations.body: Move to the designated storm shelter with your personal dosimeter and stay there until mission control gives the all-clear.

recommendations.title: Check that your dosimeter is worn and recording
recommendations.body: Confirm your personal dosimeter is worn, powered and syncing, so your dose during the event is recorded accurately.
